claims.evidence: No manufacturer nameplate, engine code stamp, or VIN tag is visible on the block or components; witness could only identify it as a generic used engine assembly.
Import history, customs paperwork, or shipping documents are not shown in the photo.
No start-up video, compression test, or diagnostic readout is present; photo is a static shot of an engine on a floor.
Requires audio/video of running engine, which is not provided.
No odometer photo, maintenance log, or donor vehicle documentation visible.
No clear shot of factory seals, untouched bolts, or timing cover fasteners to confirm it hasn't been disassembled.

risks.risk: Engine identity/model may not match seller's claim (no visible nameplate or code).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of engine block casting number, ECU/engine code sticker, or stamped ID plate.
risks.if_unproven: price as unidentified generic used engine, not brand/model specific

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal mechanical faults (bearings, rings, knock).
risks.proof: Video of cold start, idle, and revving with audible sound, plus a compression test reading.

risks.risk: True mileage/hours of use unknown; corrosion and grease suggest significant age or poor storage.
risks.proof: Donor vehicle odometer photo or maintenance records tied to this engine.

risks.risk: Import/origin claim (Tokunbo via Belgium) cannot be confirmed, affecting authenticity and resale value.
risks.proof: Bill of lading, customs clearance document, or import permit showing engine/vehicle origin.

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (sensors, injectors, turbo) uncertain for resale/installation value.
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set showing all accessory mounting points and parts present.
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete, missing standard accessories

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, weld repairs, or oil/coolant leaks not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Multiple close-up photos of block, head, and oil pan from different angles, plus a leak-down test.

proof_requests: Clear photo of engine ID plate, block casting number, or ECU code sticker
Video of engine cold-starting and idling with audible sound
Compression test results for all cylinders
Import/customs documentation showing origin and Tokunbo status
Photos from multiple angles showing full accessory completeness and any cracks or repairs
Oil and coolant condition check (dipstick/cap photos)
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used car engine assembly, which can be priced at worst case, but no photo evidence supports any of the seller's specific claims about model, origin, mileage, or working condition.
